claims: The Square Packing Atlas, site/www/ deployed at https://evand.github.io/square-packing/ by .github/workflows/pages.yml with s12/docs/ at /s12/, /s13/, /s21/, /s32/, /s45/, /s60/ and /k2m3/: the record packings of Ellsworth's catalogue, proven floors for n <= 100 (site/data/lower_bounds.json), and the 2026 results it marks 'proved in 2026, unrefereed, verified on jlevy/squares': s(11), s(21), s(32), s(45), s(59), s(60), s(61), s(77), s(78) and the families s(k^2 - c) = k for c = 1, 2, 3, with c = 4 to follow when jlevy/squares has replayed T-081 (site/www/js/overview.js, site/www/index.html)

Open problems and conjectures on Friedman's staircase c*(k), wasted space, non-integer plateaus, the complexity of optimal packings, local and plateau optimality, single values and neighbouring problems (site/www/problems.html; working list s12/search/WISHLIST.md)

s(20) > 3 + 4 sqrt(2)/3, so s(19) < s(20): a D4-invariant point cover of [0, 2443/500]^2, 12,864 points of total 249862891/12500000 < 20, certified by zmx2 (commit b8157df) and zm_mixed.py, superseded as a bound by wand125's s(20) >= 1959/400 and kept as an independent confirmation (s12/search/S20_LB.md), reviewed with no soundness defect (s12/tasks/s20-review/REPORT.md)

No pure closed cover proves s(17) >= 4.660 or s(19) >= 4.8856: exact fractional packing ceilings nu_f(4.660) >= 17044695833/10^9 and nu_f(4.8856) >= 77500070540/3999999999 (s12/search/CEILINGS_17_20.md)

Lean 4: Lemma U (LEB) and Lemma K (CAP) proved sound and all 689 LEB and 374 CAP leaves of the ValidTilt7 run V3 kernel-checked (s12/lean/Sqpack/LebMass.lean, LebMass7.lean, s12/notes/lean-leb-mass.md), beside bentz_of_validTilt7 : ValidTilt7 -> forall k >= 6, minSide (k^2 - 3) = k (s12/lean/Sqpack/ValidSplit7.lean)
Lean 4: chelokot's IsMinimumSide, restated from his Geometry.lean at 753079e, is equivalent to minSide n = s for every n >= 1 (s12/lean/Sqpack/SpecChelokot.lean)
s(k^2 - 4) = k for every k >= 5, the write-up published at /k2m4/ (site/www/k2m4/index.html)
